messages.author: 8aa2233136ab379f
messages.subject: Re: Mentors: time to review student applications
parts:
Greetings! 

I was wondering if you would like another mentor for the RcppDeepState project, as I am interested in looking after that (provided or assuming that project is selected). 

Having dealt with GitHub Actions (ironically, for last year's GSoC project!) for a decent amount of time, I can help in the area of workflow automation, along with the other technologies involved in the project (such as R and C++), given they are ones I'm well familiar with.

Also, I'm currently researching and working on applying DeepState to NASA's F' or fprime open-source software by building a test harness (test drivers and stubs/boilerplate, with my current focus being command generation) for it. Thus, this seemed pretty relevant to my work for the summer (given that DeepState is a core part of it), and I will be more than happy to mentor this project for a selected student if possible or required.

Best regards,
Anirban
